decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted  therewith  (PL/04 and PL/03 Received 23/10/12) and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 4 - No additional windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the flank walls of the extension hereby approved and no additional doors inserted in the building without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.
description: Variation of Condition 2 (approved plans) to allow changes to planning permission 01176/24A/P1 dated 12/06/2012 for "Re-modelling of property including the demolition of existing ground floor rear extension along with the removal of part of existing main roof and creation of new roof with rear dormer, with further internal and external alterations including ground and first floor rear extensions".
